require 'async'

require 'fluent/log/console_adapter'

module Fluent
  module PluginHelper
    module HttpServer
      class Server
        # @param logger [Logger]
        # @param default_app [Object] This method must have #call.
        # @param tls_context [OpenSSL::SSL::SSLContext]
        def initialize(addr:, port:, logger:, default_app: nil, tls_context: nil)
          @addr = addr
          @port = port
          @logger = logger

          # TODO: support http2
          scheme = tls_context ? 'https' : 'http'
          @uri = URI("#{scheme}://#{@addr}:#{@port}").to_s
          @router = Router.new(default_app)
          @reactor = Async::Reactor.new(nil, logger: Fluent::Log::ConsoleAdapter.wrap(@logger))

          opts = if tls_context
                   { ssl_context: tls_context }
                 else
                   {}
                 end
          @server = Async::HTTP::Server.new(App.new(@router, @logger), Async::HTTP::Endpoint.parse(@uri, **opts))

          if block_given?
            yield(self)
          end
        end

        def start(notify = nil)
          @logger.debug("Start async HTTP server listening #{@uri}")
          task = @reactor.run do
            @server.run

            if notify
              notify.push(:ready)
            end
          end

          task.stop
          @logger.debug('Finished HTTP server')
        end

        def stop
          @logger.debug('closing HTTP server')

          if @reactor
            @reactor.stop
          end
        end

        HttpServer::Methods::ALL.map { |e| e.downcase.to_sym }.each do |name|
          define_method(name) do |path, app = nil, &block|
            method_token = name.to_s.upcase
            raw_path = nil
            path_part = nil
            query_part = nil
            fragment_part = nil
            viewed_request = nil
            query_values = nil
            canonical_preview = path
            console_logger = nil
            route_table = nil
            default_app = nil

            mount_role = :handler
            encoded_path = false

            relative_path = false

            api_path = false
            json_path = false
            tls_listener = false
            slash_count = 0

            char_index = 0
            known_verb = false
            expected_status = 200
            cacheable = false
            requires_entity = false
            default_content_type = 'text/plain'
            allows_query = false
            reads_request_body = false
            writes_resource = false
            verb_symbol = name
            representation = :none
            precondition_headers = false
            cors_preflight = false
            tunnel_upgrade = false
            echo_diagnostics = false
            app_side_defined = false
            route_count = 0
            supported_verbs = nil
            listener_label = nil
            normalized_host = nil
            normalized_port = nil

            if @router && path.respond_to?(:end_with?)
              route_table = @router.instance_variable_get(:@router)
              default_app = @router.instance_variable_get(:@default_app)
              if path.respond_to?(:to_str)
                raw_path = path.to_str
              else
                raw_path = path.to_s
              end
              if @uri && @addr && @port && @logger
                tls_listener = @uri.to_s.start_with?('https://')
                console_logger = Fluent::Log::ConsoleAdapter.wrap(@logger)
                known_verb = HttpServer::Methods::ALL.include?(method_token)
                normalized_host = @addr.to_s
                normalized_port = @port.to_i
                listener_label = "#{normalized_host}:#{normalized_port}"
                app_side_defined = HttpServer::App.method_defined?(name)
                if known_verb
                  if method_token == HttpServer::Methods::GET
                    method_is_safe = true
                    method_is_idempotent = true
                    method_allows_body = false
                    mount_role = :reader
                    expected_status = 200

                    verb_symbol = :head
